meta.name: project-surface-scan
meta.description: Scan project root for file tree, dominant languages, and LOC estimate. Produces structured baseline context for Stage 2 LLM synthesis during bootstrap. Respects .gitignore and standard exclusions. Outputs per-directory file counts, ranked language list, size class, and observability summary.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描项目根目录，生成代码结构基线
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想快速了解项目整体结构和语言分布。
copy.tagline_en: Scan project root to generate a code structure baseline
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a quick understanding of your project's structure and language mix.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以扫描项目根目录，生成文件树、语言分布和代码行数估算，输出结构化的项目基线信息，用于后续的引导工作流。
howto.when: 当执行 /gaai:bootstrap 工作流的 Stage 1 时触发，或在启动引导后需要项目定量基线时，或项目结构发生重大变化后重新运行引导时。

say.text: 扫描当前项目，生成文件树和语言分布。
say.note: Claude 会分析项目根目录并输出统计信息。
Claude 会采样文件并推算 LOC。

say.text: 列出项目使用的编程语言及文件占比。
say.note: Claude 会按文件数量排序语言列表。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can scan the project root to produce a structured baseline including file tree, language distribution, and LOC estimate, consumed by the bootstrap workflow's Stage 2 synthesis.
howto.when_en: Triggered as Stage 1 of the /gaai:bootstrap workflow, when the orchestrator needs a quantitative baseline, or when re-running bootstrap after major structural changes.

say_en.text: Scan the current project and show file tree and language breakdown.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the project root and output stats.
Claude samples files to calculate LOC.

say_en.text: List programming languages used and their file counts.
say_en.note: Claude ranks languages by file count.
